label: VERIFIED
extraction: ATC (Agent Task Coordinator): multi-agent task orchestration with kanban board for AI coding agents. Coordinates multiple AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) working on same codebase. Provides: task locking, branch isolation via git worktrees, real-time dashboard to monitor everything. Addresses coordination as first-class concern rather than afterthought. Most multi-agent frameworks leave coordination to user; ATC provides structured coordination primitives.
